desc: Resistance to Death Rune (blade rune spell) suffer ½ damage inflicted by the rune upon discharge, and fall unconscious for only 30 seconds per 6 points of damage taken, from 1 minute. Further purchases of the resistance do not lessen the time per 6 pts of damage, but if the damage taken becomes less than 6 points the character does not fall unconscious.
